name: HERO
note: Official sponsor of the Pertamina Enduro VR46 Racing Team (2026 team Sponsors page). Paint-dispensing machine maker; its own site (eu.hero.ca) names the entities HERO Europe S.r.l. (Salmour, CN), HERO Products Group (Canada) and HERO Equipment GmbH (Köln). Who owns the companies is not published, so left unrated.
